name: ASA: The Video Game
description: ASA: The Video Game - a 16-bit incremental strategy. Run the yard, form the Tech Team, launch the probes, convert the universe. Unlocked at Woogy's Emporium.
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: None - buy it at Woogy's Emporium with tickets to unlock it, then launch it from the Library.
how_it_works: An incremental-strategy game: grow American Steel from the yard through tech, drones, and space, then convert the universe.
Manage a power economy and make choices along the way that steer the ending.
output: It's a game - no work files. Reach one of the endings, then rest or start a new universe.
